entries.name: Generic
entries.description: A minimal, system-agnostic character sheet — a starting point to duplicate and edit.
entries.author: DM Toolkit

entries.name: D&D 5e (basic)
entries.description: D&D 5e-compatible mechanics: abilities, skills & saves as proficiency rosters, spell slots, a weapons table. Mechanics only — no rulebook text.
entries.author: DM Toolkit
entries.changelogExcerpt: All twelve SRD classes on the sheet, the NPC stat-block template, and identity + derived fields (v1.12.0).

entries.name: GURPS (basic)
entries.description: GURPS-compatible mechanics: ST/DX/IQ/HT, derived characteristics, HP/FP pools, skills, traits, weapons & DR tables. Mechanics only.
entries.author: DM Toolkit
entries.changelogExcerpt: Equipment is now a table (item · TL · LC · qty · weight · cost · notes · page-ref) so GURPS gear imports with full detail (v1.8.0).

entries.name: D&D 5e SRD content
entries.description: The complete SRD 5.2.1 content for the dnd5e-basic ruleset: conditions, actions, common rules, every spell, the full bestiary, all magic items, and mundane equipment. Attach to a D&D campaign.
